description: orders-api /readyz reports inventory_api true and status ready
orders-api readiness code probes /healthz on inventory-api, not /health
command: grep -q 'inventory_api_url}/healthz' app/orders-api/src/health.py && echo pass || echo fail

description: Helm chart orders-api readiness probe path is /healthz
YOUR CONTEXT FILE: app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md exists — the service carries written instructions for whoever picks it up next, human or agent
YOUR CONTEXT FILE: it declares all three sections — evidence to collect first, change rules, and how the service is verified
command: F=app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md; [ -f $F ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -qi 'evidence' $F && grep -qi 'change rules' $F && grep -qi 'verif' $F && echo complete || echo incomplete

description: YOUR CONTEXT FILE: it names the grader as the authority on done — so an agent reading it learns the repository owns the verdict, not the agent
command: F=app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md; [ -f $F ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -q 'grade.sh m1' $F && echo names-grader || echo silent

description: YOUR CONTEXT FILE: it states the branch-only rule — repairs are proposals on a branch, never direct commits to main
command: F=app/orders-api/CLAUDE.md; [ -f $F ] || { echo missing; exit 0; }; grep -Eqi 'never (commit|push)[^.]*main|branch' $F && echo branch-rule || echo absent

description: YOUR REPAIR: the fix is committed into main's history since m1-start — the repair was made and landed, not just left in the working tree
command: n=$(git log m1-start..main --oneline -- app/orders-api/src/health.py platform/helm/orders-api/values.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && echo landed || echo not-landed
